card.name: Measures such as mg after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word right after a number in dosing text, mostly mg and the g of mcg, and sometimes mL or days. It appears in starting doses, dose steps and tapering rates.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: The unit mg or mcg right after a dose number in dosing instructions.
modes.example: The recommended starting oral dosage of CLOZARIL is 12.5<< mg>> once or twice daily.

modes.label: Other measures
modes.description: A volume or time unit after a number in trial results.

card.plain: It marks the unit, such as mg, that follows a dose number in dosing directions.
